tools.name: get_connected_purchase
tools.description: Identify the existing Ocolta purchase connected for this conversation. Returns available review count and supported report-summary access; does not expose payment details or account identifiers.

tools.name: list_recent_reviews
tools.description: List up to ten completed, recoverable Deep Reviews from the existing purchase you connected. Use when you ask which review summaries are still available within the 24-hour recovery period. No new review or credit spend is started.

tools.name: get_review_summary
tools.description: Retrieve categorical document-review status, review priority, confidence and fraud/AI indicator counts for one recoverable review from the connected purchase. Provides signals for human follow-up without source documents, personal fields or free-text excerpts. This does not prove fraud, authenticity
